name: MEV bot 0xa47b unguarded callback
summary: The MEV bot accepted an unauthenticated Balancer flash-loan callback and delegated execution to addresses supplied through callback calldata. The attacker made that path transfer the bot's WETH to attacker-controlled code and used the proceeds in an arbitrage transaction.

loss.notes: The exploit receipt shows 187.745915823040341329 WETH leaving the bot for attacker-controlled helper 0x2d0037e6e417baef5adc0d521dd127e724279bfe. A 1 WETH Balancer flash-loan transfer into the bot and its 1 WETH repayment cancel, leaving the same exact net bot depletion. No recovery is netted.

ageReset.description: The bot address was an operator-controlled metamorphic CREATE2 slot. After the previous runtime self-destructed, this transaction recreated the address with the 556-byte runtime later exploited. It was the last of 17 successful creations before the incident, and the runtime remained byte-identical through exploitation.

sources.note: The exploit transaction sends a Balancer flash loan through attacker contract 0x4b77c789fa35b54dacb5f6bb2daaa01554299d6c, which asks the Vault to transfer 1 WETH to the bot and invoke callback selector 0xf04f2707. The bot callback executes despite the untrusted call path. Its trace delegates first to caller-supplied target 0x770200a211315a0688c289f437317ea117cb4d23 and later to 0xfbc83fa919e6c83d9d9ccc1171df44d624da4c25; the resulting calls transfer 187.745915823040341329 WETH from the bot to attacker-controlled helper 0x2d0037e6e417baef5adc0d521dd127e724279bfe. Receipt transfers show the bot received and repaid exactly 1 WETH to Balancer in addition to that theft, so its net WETH depletion is exactly 187.745915823040341329. At the timestamped DefiLlama ETH price of $1,290.89, gross loss is $242,359.32527680453. The bot was first CREATE2-deployed by factory 0xdc3c2c78ef0e11952af23dccd8e24a0a64c9d20e inside source-3 at block 14499949:140. Historical internal-creation records show 17 successful recreations at the same address through the incident. The last was source-4 at block 15532252:51: its transaction-start prestate has no bot code, its call trace shows the same factory CREATE2-deploying the bot, and the creation returns a 556-byte runtime hashing to 0x39d1ea2f6ba18431166364920ccbcd6eaea9b37faabd10e550b7f3529095c347. The address has empty code in the preceding block and that exact runtime at the redeployment block and immediately before exploitation. Its fallback copies calldata and delegate-calls an address derived from that calldata without authenticating the caller; its separate self-destruct function is restricted to the factory. The exploited runtime was 2,541,184 seconds old.
